about.title: About
about.textTitle: 4 years of experience · 10+ projects · From web apps to evolving systems
text: I've gone from simple landing pages and interfaces to systems where reliability, performance, and every transaction matter. Today I work across the whole product — from architecture and backend to frontend — with a focus on keeping the system stable and predictable as it grows.

To me, a good project isn't one that simply works today. It's a system that's easy to evolve tomorrow: adding new features, scaling individual parts, and catching problems before users ever run into them.
That's why I value simple architecture and readable code. A developer should be able to open a project and understand it — not have to decode it.

items.role: Whole products, from architecture to interface
items.text: Ten-plus projects built from scratch: data schema, services and queues, frontend, shipping to production and support. MVP in three weeks on average.
Systems where every transaction matters: profiling and speeding up queries, metrics and traces across services, alerts based on real symptoms — catching issues before users do.
A system that's easy to evolve: add features, scale individual parts. A developer opens the project and understands it, rather than having to decode it.
